repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhshTXCAmv9KJXRZkB ## 席位核对 · L1 (seat 3, L1-a) · 2026-11-17T07:21Z L1: ACCEPT Head-sha: bc7e8125a7481593c319544a023c0f4f9f7ccb82 Card: #34595 · claim 6938560309 · surface amendment 6940603112 · os-dev reports 6940580900 (head fa5f2a01) and 6941163170 (fix round, head bc7e8125) The three card items are built as asked, the desktop paths are untouched, and every out-of-surface test file is covered by the amendment. The fix round's cause and repair are read and hold. No must-fix and no should-fix. The notes below are for the seat and are not bars. ### Must-fix None. ### Should-fix None. ### Readings that hold | Item | Reading | |:--|:--| | PR shape | Draft, base `main`, `Fixes #34595`, with no other closing verb. No `!` and no `(narrowing)`, so no dogfood battery is owed. | | Scope | 11 files: the three claimed sources (`containers.tsx` +17/−11, `record-path.tsx`, `HeaderHighlight.tsx`), two new tests named by card, the changeset, four existing tests and the rewritten `ui/e2e/record-path-phone-row.spec.ts`. The amendment 6940603112 names all four existing tests and the e2e rewrite. No source file is outside the original surface, and no locale file is touched. | | Clause-② / Metadata-protocol | `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` in the claim, amendment, PR body and changeset. Read against the diff: no export is added (`PageHeaderActionsProps.face` only changes its jsdoc, and `RecordPathProps` is untouched). There is no spec, schema or locale key. `form.stepOf` and `detail.pathLabel` are existing keys. `page:header.mobileMaxVisible` keeps its meaning as the bar's budget. | | Changeset | `patch` on `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, the two published packages whose `src` moved. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private and only its test moved. Sentences read against the diff:
• "On an editable record the bar is now Edit, the primary action, then the `⋯`" = `barQueue = [...ranked.filter(isHostButton), primary?, ...authoredButtons]`, deduped, with `inlineActions = barQueue.slice(0, maxVisible)`.
• "A destructive host action (Delete) still always goes in the `⋯`" = `isHostButton` excludes it, so it never enters the queue.
• "A record the reader cannot edit keeps the primary and one more" = no host button, so the queue starts at the primary.
• "The step counts the forward stages; a record on a lost stage … with no step" = `total: forwardStages.length`. `forwardStages` is `pathStages.slice(0, firstLostIdx)` and the lost group is the suffix, so `currentIdx + 1` is the forward position. `phoneStep` is `null` when `currentInLost`.
• "each reachable stage there moves the record, behind the same permission and state-machine checks" = the list lines go through the same `renderStage`, whose `press` is `stageChange.pressable && state !== 'current' && stageChange.admits(...)`.
• "Below `sm` the strip is a two-column grid" = `max-sm:grid max-sm:grid-cols-2` on the row and `max-sm:min-w-0` on each chip.
All true. Desktop: the `row` face keeps `isHostButton(a) \|\| inlineAuthored.has(a)` over `authoredButtons.slice(0, maxVisible)`, the same set as before. The desktop rail block is untouched, and the strip's `max-sm:` tokens do not apply from `sm` up. | | Fix round (bc7e8125) | Root cause: `React.useId` in the compact list made two renders of the same record differ, so `record-block-record-reach.test.tsx`'s byte-identity control failed. The fix removes the id and `aria-controls`. The list is the button's next sibling and `aria-expanded` carries the open state, and the new test pins both. The red leg (record-path.tsx from fa5f2a01 makes 1 of 13 fail in that file) and the green leg (114 files / 1178 tests) are in report 6941163170. Restored, with `git diff HEAD` empty. | | Existing-test edits | Each one changes only the pinned order or layout tokens to the new behaviour and cites #34595, and none drops a guard. The bar tests still assert that Delete is last in the `⋯` and that the header draws no action row. They also add `not.toContain('Edit')` in the `⋯`. `record-path.phoneRow-26897` keeps "no `truncate`, no `whitespace-nowrap`", adds `[overflow-wrap:anywhere]`, and drops the `title` pin because the label is no longer cut. `HeaderHighlight…12523` swaps `max-sm:basis-full` for `max-sm:min-w-0` and keeps the other three tokens. | | E2E rewrite | `record-path-phone-row.spec.ts` still reads its classes out of `record-path.tsx` at run time (`PHONE_RAIL_ROW_CLASS`, `PHONE_RAIL_SEGMENT_CLASS`, `PHONE_SUMMARY_CLASS`, `PHONE_SUMMARY_STAGE_CLASS`), so the source and its geometry pin cannot drift apart. It measures 320/375/390 px, a wrapping long name, and a 20-stage rail. | | UI strings | The only visible strings are `t('form.stepOf', …)` and `t('detail.pathLabel')`. `stepOf` is in all 11 packs (zh-Hans `第 {{current}} 步，共 {{total}} 步`), and so is `pathLabel` (zh-Hans `记录路径`). The inline `defaultValue` matches en byte for byte. `·` and `✗` are `aria-hidden` glyphs. | | Docs | Searched `content/docs`, `skills` and the ui READMEs for the phone bar order, the phone stage row and the phone highlight strip. None describes them, so nothing is made false (see Notes 1 for an older sentence). | | Acceptance | 1: `[Edit][Generate Quote][⋯]` is pinned in the components harness and in the app-shell record page (`[Edit][Convert Lead][⋯]`). 2: "Step 5 of 6 · Negotiation" plus the zh copy is pinned, and Chromium shows the name whole at 320/375/390. 3: six chips in three rows is pinned by class, and a compiled-Tailwind fixture reads `columns=2 rows=3` at 375 px. The live Console at 375 px is declared NOT MEASURED. | | Tests | Real commands with output: 865 files / 8059 tests on fa5f2a01 under the verify lock, plus the fix-round legs on bc7e8125. Three ablations: 5/11, 1/4 and 2/8 red, each restored to an empty `git diff HEAD`. 38 derived gates, 38 run. | | Tier | `check-governed-merges --pr 34684`: NOT governed, 0 of 11 paths, 833 lines. Tier S, lands through o3-A. | | CI on this head | 62 check-runs, all `success` or `skipped`, none pending. Test UI 16/16 shards plus the aggregate are `success`, so the fa5f2a01 red shard 11/16 is green on this head. Type Check UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI, Check Changeset, Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Governed Surface Queue Guard and PR-body guards are all `success`. | ### Notes 1. **An older page doc does not describe the phone bar (not made false here).** The generated `content/docs/ui/components/page.mdx` (from the spec description) says host buttons "take no slot and never fold" and `mobileMaxVisible` defaults to 1. On the phone bar Edit has taken a slot since #27058, and the bar's budget is `PHONE_ACTION_BAR_BUTTONS = 2`. That was already true before this PR, and the text lives in `packages/spec`, outside this surface. A p3 docs card would line it up with the bar face. 2. **The strip reverses objectui#12523's full-line choice on purpose.** That PR kept one chip per line because a ~150 px cell cuts a phone number or email and a touch screen cannot hover a `title`. Card item 3 (maintainer epic #34571) asks for two columns, and the PR comment says so. Long phone and email values now end in an ellipsis on a phone. That ties to #34614 (badge truncation and wrapping, serial after this card). 3. **Lost stage in the compact summary.** The ✗ and the destructive colour are visual only, so on a lost record the summary button's accessible name is just the stage label. The list lines still announce state through `stageAriaLabel`. Small, and not in the card. 4. **Declared deviation: Claim plus Edit on a queue record.** On a queue record the primary folds when Claim is offered. Host buttons lead, and `mobileMaxVisible: 3` shows all three. The PR body records that the seat accepted it. I read it as consistent with the desktop rule that a host button never folds.
